catalog_release_publication_check.name: catalog_release_publication_check
catalog_release_publication_check.value:
("catalog_release"."status" = 'draft' and "catalog_release"."published_at" is null)
        or ("catalog_release"."status" in ('published', 'revoked') and "catalog_release"."published_at" is not null)

dietary_constraint_target_check.name: dietary_constraint_target_check
dietary_constraint_target_check.value: "dietary_constraint"."food_id" is not null or "dietary_constraint"."label_ko" is not null

nutrient_profile_nonnegative_values_chec.name: nutrient_profile_nonnegative_values_check
nutrient_profile_nonnegative_values_chec.value:
("nutrient_profile"."energy_millicalories" is null or "nutrient_profile"."energy_millicalories" >= 0)
        and ("nutrient_profile"."carbohydrate_mg" is null or "nutrient_profile"."carbohydrate_mg" >= 0)
        and ("nutrient_profile"."protein_mg" is null or "nutrient_profile"."protein_mg" >= 0)
        and ("nutrient_profile"."fat_mg" is null or "nutrient_profile"."fat_mg" >= 0)
        and ("nutrient_profile"."fiber_mg" is null or "nutrient_profile"."fiber_mg" >= 0)

source_release_publication_check.name: source_release_publication_check
source_release_publication_check.value:
("source_release"."status" = 'draft' and "source_release"."published_at" is null)
        or ("source_release"."status" in ('published', 'revoked') and "source_release"."published_at" is not null)

calculation_snapshot_confirmation_idempo.name: calculation_snapshot_confirmation_idempotency_check
calculation_snapshot_confirmation_idempo.value:
("calculation_snapshot"."confirmation_idempotency_key" is null and "calculation_snapshot"."confirmation_fingerprint" is null)
        or ("calculation_snapshot"."confirmation_idempotency_key" is not null and "calculation_snapshot"."confirmation_fingerprint" is not null)

calculation_snapshot_values_check.name: calculation_snapshot_values_check
calculation_snapshot_values_check.value:
("calculation_snapshot"."energy_millicalories" is null or "calculation_snapshot"."energy_millicalories" >= 0)
        and ("calculation_snapshot"."carbohydrate_mg" is null or "calculation_snapshot"."carbohydrate_mg" >= 0)
        and ("calculation_snapshot"."protein_mg" is null or "calculation_snapshot"."protein_mg" >= 0)
        and ("calculation_snapshot"."fat_mg" is null or "calculation_snapshot"."fat_mg" >= 0)
        and ("calculation_snapshot"."fiber_mg" is null or "calculation_snapshot"."fiber_mg" >= 0)

image_asset_dimensions_check.name: image_asset_dimensions_check
image_asset_dimensions_check.value:
("image_asset"."pixel_width" is null and "image_asset"."pixel_height" is null)
        or ("image_asset"."pixel_width" > 0 and "image_asset"."pixel_height" > 0)

image_asset_status_timestamps_check.name: image_asset_status_timestamps_check
image_asset_status_timestamps_check.value:
("image_asset"."status" <> 'processed' or "image_asset"."processing_completed_at" is not null)
        and ("image_asset"."status" <> 'deletion_pending' or "image_asset"."deletion_requested_at" is not null)
        and ("image_asset"."status" <> 'deleted' or "image_asset"."deleted_at" is not null)

meal_item_confidence_check.name: meal_item_confidence_check
meal_item_confidence_check.value:
("meal_item"."recognition_confidence_bps" is null or "meal_item"."recognition_confidence_bps" between 0 and 10000)
        and ("meal_item"."mapping_confidence_bps" is null or "meal_item"."mapping_confidence_bps" between 0 and 10000)
        and ("meal_item"."portion_confidence_bps" is null or "meal_item"."portion_confidence_bps" between 0 and 10000)

meal_item_revision_check.name: meal_item_revision_check
meal_item_revision_check.value:
"meal_item"."item_revision" > 0
        and "meal_item"."food_revision" > 0
        and "meal_item"."portion_revision" > 0
        and ("meal_item"."food_acknowledged_revision" is null
          or ("meal_item"."food_acknowledged_revision" > 0
            and "meal_item"."food_acknowledged_revision" <= "meal_item"."food_revision"))
        and ("meal_item"."portion_acknowledged_revision" is null
          or ("meal_item"."portion_acknowledged_revision" > 0
            and "meal_item"."portion_acknowledged_revision" <= "meal_item"."portion_revision"))

meal_item_initial_estimate_origin_check.name: meal_item_initial_estimate_origin_check
meal_item_initial_estimate_origin_check.value:
("meal_item"."origin" = 'model_estimate'
          and "meal_item"."initial_estimate_assessment" is not null
          and "meal_item"."initial_estimate_assessment" ? 'initialFoodId'
          and "meal_item"."initial_estimate_assessment" ? 'initialNutrientProfileId'
          and "meal_item"."initial_estimate_assessment"->>'recognitionProvider' in ('mock', 'openai')
          and "meal_item"."initial_estimate_assessment" ? 'recognitionModel'
          and "meal_item"."initial_estimate_assessment" ? 'recognitionPromptVersion'
          and "meal_item"."initial_estimate_assessment" ? 'recognitionSchemaVersion')
        or ("meal_item"."origin" <> 'model_estimate' and "meal_item"."initial_estimate_assessment" is null)

meal_log_recognition_processing_lease_ch.name: meal_log_recognition_processing_lease_check
meal_log_recognition_processing_lease_ch.value:
("meal_log"."recognition_status" = 'processing'
        and "meal_log"."recognition_lease_token" is not null
        and "meal_log"."recognition_lease_expires_at" is not null)
        or ("meal_log"."recognition_status" <> 'processing'
        and "meal_log"."recognition_lease_token" is null
        and "meal_log"."recognition_lease_expires_at" is null)

meal_log_recognition_ready_check.name: meal_log_recognition_ready_check
meal_log_recognition_ready_check.value:
"meal_log"."recognition_status" <> 'ready'
        or ("meal_log"."recognition_provider" is not null
        and "meal_log"."recognition_model" is not null
        and "meal_log"."recognition_prompt_version" is not null
        and "meal_log"."recognition_schema_version" is not null
        and "meal_log"."recognition_result" is not null
        and jsonb_typeof("meal_log"."recognition_result") = 'object'
        and (
          ("meal_log"."recognition_result"->>'version' = '2'
            and "meal_log"."recognition_result" ? 'foods'
            and jsonb_typeof("meal_log"."recognition_result"->'foods') = 'array')
          or ("meal_log"."recognition_result"->>'version' = '3'
            and "meal_log"."recognition_result" ? 'observations'
            and jsonb_typeof("meal_log"."recognition_result"->'observations') = 'array')
        )
        and "meal_log"."recognition_completed_at" is not null)

meal_log_recognition_manual_override_che.name: meal_log_recognition_manual_override_check
meal_log_recognition_manual_override_che.value:
"meal_log"."recognition_manual_override" is null
        or ("meal_log"."recognition_status" = 'manual'
        and "meal_log"."recognition_manual_override"->>'fromStatus' in ('ready', 'pending', 'processing', 'failed')
        and "meal_log"."recognition_manual_override"->>'decision' = 'direct_entry'
        and "meal_log"."recognition_manual_override"->>'decisionVersion' = 'recognition-manual-override-v1'
        and "meal_log"."recognition_manual_override" ? 'actorUserId'
        and jsonb_typeof("meal_log"."recognition_manual_override"->'expectedDraftRevision') = 'number'
        and jsonb_typeof("meal_log"."recognition_manual_override"->'changedFields') = 'array'
        and "meal_log"."recognition_manual_override" ? 'decidedAt'
        and ("meal_log"."recognition_manual_override"->>'fromStatus' <> 'ready'
          or ("meal_log"."recognition_result" is not null
            and "meal_log"."recognition_result"->>'outcome' in ('no_food', 'insufficient_evidence')
            and "meal_log"."recognition_manual_override"->>'fromOutcome' = "meal_log"."recognition_result"->>'outcome')))

meal_log_status_timestamps_check.name: meal_log_status_timestamps_check
meal_log_status_timestamps_check.value:
("meal_log"."status" <> 'confirmed' or "meal_log"."confirmed_at" is not null)
        and ("meal_log"."status" <> 'deleted' or ("meal_log"."deleted_at" is not null and "meal_log"."purge_after" is not null))

recognition_attempt_lease_check.name: recognition_attempt_lease_check
recognition_attempt_lease_check.value: ("recognition_attempt"."status" = 'processing' and "recognition_attempt"."lease_token" is not null and "recognition_attempt"."lease_expires_at" is not null) or ("recognition_attempt"."status" <> 'processing' and "recognition_attempt"."lease_token" is null and "recognition_attempt"."lease_expires_at" is null)

resolution_attempt_lease_check.name: resolution_attempt_lease_check
resolution_attempt_lease_check.value: ("resolution_attempt"."status" = 'processing' and "resolution_attempt"."lease_token" is not null and "resolution_attempt"."lease_expires_at" is not null) or ("resolution_attempt"."status" <> 'processing' and "resolution_attempt"."lease_token" is null and "resolution_attempt"."lease_expires_at" is null)

nutrition_profile_body_metrics_check.name: nutrition_profile_body_metrics_check
nutrition_profile_body_metrics_check.value:
("nutrition_profile"."birth_year" is null or "nutrition_profile"."birth_year" between 1900 and 2100)
        and ("nutrition_profile"."height_mm" is null or "nutrition_profile"."height_mm" > 0)
        and ("nutrition_profile"."weight_g" is null or "nutrition_profile"."weight_g" > 0)

nutrition_profile_targets_check.name: nutrition_profile_targets_check
nutrition_profile_targets_check.value:
"nutrition_profile"."calorie_target_millicalories" > 0
        and "nutrition_profile"."carbohydrate_target_mg" >= 0
        and "nutrition_profile"."protein_target_mg" >= 0
        and "nutrition_profile"."fat_target_mg" >= 0
        and "nutrition_profile"."fiber_target_mg" >= 0
        and "nutrition_profile"."activity_coefficient_bps" > 0
        and "nutrition_profile"."base_eer_millicalories" > 0

user_profile_onboarding_status_check.name: user_profile_onboarding_status_check
user_profile_onboarding_status_check.value:
("user_profile"."onboarding_status" = 'pending' and "user_profile"."onboarding_completed_at" is null)
        or ("user_profile"."onboarding_status" <> 'pending' and "user_profile"."onboarding_completed_at" is not null)

catalog_backfill_checkpoint_status_check.name: catalog_backfill_checkpoint_status_check
catalog_backfill_checkpoint_status_check.value: ("catalog_backfill_checkpoint"."status" = 'running' and "catalog_backfill_checkpoint"."completed_at" is null) or ("catalog_backfill_checkpoint"."status" = 'complete' and "catalog_backfill_checkpoint"."completed_at" is not null)
